Maya Chen: kicking off canary for feature-flag=smart-caching on slice7 -> 2% traffic. latency looks stable so far but saw a small 5xx blip around 13:04 UTC from redis GETs. rolling back bad nodes now. pinging SRE for extra watch :eyes:
Jon Patel: saw that spike. looks like connection exhaustion to redis read replicas. i'm increasing pool and redeploying the redis sidecars now. will post commands shortly.
ops-bot: deploy triggered: canary/slice7 @ 2% by Maya (deploy-id: d-2481002222) :rocket:
Alex Rivera: thanks — can you paste the k8s pod query you used? want to check restarts and node info.
Maya Chen: sure — commands i'm using:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l slice=slice7 -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs -f deployment/canary-slice7 --tail=200
```
Lisa Park: i'll keep an eye on error_budget and raise the alert if it trends up. i've bumped the transient alert threshold to 1.5x for the next 15m. if 5xx persists >3m we rollback to v1.2.3.
Jon Patel: tweak applied to redis sidecars: `sed -i 's/maxclients .*/maxclients 300/' /etc/redis/redis.conf && systemctl restart redis` — adding to runbook.
Maya Chen: perf dashboard (last 15m): https://dash.redwood.ai/slice7?from=now-15m — no sustained latency spike, just the short error blip.
qa-bot: smoke tests: generation ✅, embeddings ✅. one rerank test flaked (seed 42) — marking ticket QA-9123 to follow up.
Alex Rivera: opening a small PR to adjust canary warmup from 5s -> 10s, tagging @Lisa for quick review.
Lisa Park: ack, on review. if we stay green for 30m i'll approve and we can ramp to 10%.
Maya Chen: no product blockers. i'll post a status update at +45m. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jon Patel: noted, will continue to monitor redis metrics and pod restarts. ping me if you see error rate > 0.5%
ops-bot: deploy status: canary/slice7 @2% - healthy (checks passed) — d-2481002222
Maya Chen: final update: 35m in, no further 5xx, ramping plan scheduled. moving to ramp -> 10% in 10m unless objection.
Lisa Park: good to go from SRE side. :white_check_mark:
